mapper.select: WITH ra AS ( SELECT DISTINCT warehouse_id, rack_no FROM wms_rack_assignment WHERE wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND effective_from <= #{today} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= #{today}) ), alloc AS ( SELECT l.warehouse_id, l.location_code FROM wms_location l JOIN ra ON ra.warehouse_id = l.warehouse_id AND ra.rack_no = l.rack_no WHERE l.deleted = 0 ), occ AS ( SELECT a.warehouse_id, a.location_code, SUM(pi.quantity) AS qty FROM alloc a JOIN wms_physical_inventory pi ON pi.warehouse_id = a.warehouse_id AND pi.location_code = a.location_code AND pi.quantity > 0 GROUP BY a.warehouse_id, a.location_code ) SELECT w.id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, w.warehouse_code AS warehouseCode, reg.region_name AS regionName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ra WHERE ra.warehouse_id = w.id) AS rackCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alloc a WHERE a.warehouse_id = w.id) AS allocatedLocations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM occ o WHERE o.warehouse_id = w.id) AS occupiedLocations, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.qty), 0) FROM occ o WHERE o.warehouse_id = w.id) AS onHandQty FROM wms_warehouse w LEFT JOIN wms_region reg ON reg.id = w.region_id WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.id IN (SELECT warehouse_id FROM ra) ORDER BY w.id

SELECT a.rack_no AS rackNo, a.monthly_fee AS monthlyFee, a.effective_to AS effectiveTo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_location l WHERE l.warehouse_id = a.warehouse_id AND l.rack_no = a.rack_no AND l.deleted = 0) AS locationCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pi.location_code) FROM wms_physical_inventory pi JOIN wms_location l2 ON l2.warehouse_id = pi.warehouse_id AND l2.location_code = pi.location_code AND l2.deleted = 0 WHERE pi.warehouse_id = a.warehouse_id AND l2.rack_no = a.rack_no AND pi.quantity > 0) AS occupiedCount FROM wms_rack_assignment a WHERE a.wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND a.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND a.effective_from <= #{today} AND (a.effective_to IS NULL OR a.effective_to >= #{today}) ORDER BY a.rack_no

SELECT pi.erp_tenant_id AS erpTenantId, t.tenant_name AS ownerName, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.location_code) AS occupiedLocations, COALESCE(SUM(pi.quantity), 0) AS onHandQty, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.sku_code) AS skuCount FROM wms_physical_inventory pi JOIN wms_location l ON l.warehouse_id = pi.warehouse_id AND l.location_code = pi.location_code AND l.deleted = 0 JOIN wms_rack_assignment a ON a.warehouse_id = pi.warehouse_id AND a.rack_no = l.rack_no AND a.wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND a.effective_from <= #{today} AND (a.effective_to IS NULL OR a.effective_to >= #{today}) LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = pi.erp_tenant_id WHERE pi.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND pi.quantity > 0 GROUP BY pi.erp_tenant_id, t.tenant_name ORDER BY onHandQty DESC
